nodes.label: Licht — fotografieportfolio template
nodes.rationale: Maatwerk-tier monochrome photography portfolio (Manrope, light). Archetype F: giant-type hero plus horizontally scrolling gallery strip. Minimal chrome so the photos dominate; dark inverted 'over' band for contrast.

nodes.label: Horizontal scroll-snap gallery strip with keyboard navigation
nodes.rationale: Signature component: CSS scroll-snap-type x mandatory strip with prev/next buttons that compute a step from card width + gap, disabled-state syncing on scroll, and full keyboard support (ArrowLeft/Right, Home, End) on a focusable role=region. Respects prefers-reduced-motion by switching smooth scrolling to auto.
